messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "daily dosage may be divided into two doses per day"
set: ["daily dosage may be divided into two doses per day", "daily dosage of immediate-release formulations may be divided into three doses per day", "daily dose divided into three equal doses", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses", "10 mg orally per day in divided doses", "150 mg orally per day in divided doses", "5 to 60 mg per day in divided doses", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses for narcolepsy", "100 mg a day, split into two doses", "given as two divided doses up to the same maximum 37.5 mg daily limit", "given in divided doses", "daily dose should be taken in divided doses 2 to 3 times a day with meals", "taken in divided doses", "taken as a single dose or split into two doses", "2000 mg/day in divided doses", "dosage may be titrated upward every 3 days"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
